case.task: Please review the details in the customer confirmation email I just received and create a new account entry in our CRM system with that company information. Afterwards, make sure to clean up and permanently remove the draft we no longer need from my email client.

candidate_tools.description: Permanently deletes a specific Gmail draft using its ID with no recovery possible; verify the correct `draft_id` and obtain explicit user confirmation before calling. Ensure the draft exists and the user has necessary permissions for the given `user_id`.
Creates a new account in Salesforce with the specified information. Returns the created Account's ID at `data.response_data.id`.
Archives a specific HubSpot CRM object by its type and ID, moving it to the recycling bin; this action is irreversible via the API but objects can often be restored via the HubSpot UI.

Fetches a specific email message by its ID, provided the `message_id` exists and is accessible to the authenticated `user_id`. Spam/trash messages are excluded unless upstream list/search calls used `include_spam_trash=true`. Use `internalDate` (milliseconds since epoch) rather than header `Date` for recency checks.

DEPRECATED: Use SALESFORCE_POST_COMPOSITE_GRAPH instead. Tool to execute multiple Salesforce REST API requests in a single call using composite graphs. Use when you need to perform a series of related operations that should either all succeed or all fail together. Composite graphs support up to 500 subrequests per graph (compared to 25 for regular composite requests) and allow referencing outputs from previous subrequests using @{referenceId.fieldName} syntax.

case.rationale: The workflow represents a common administrative task: fetching details from a specific email message to create an account in a CRM (Salesforce), followed by cleaning up an outdated email draft. The required tools match these steps precisely, while HubSpot and the deprecated Salesforce composite graph tool are correctly omitted.

CONSTANT_CONTACT_DELETE_EMAIL_CAMPAIGN.description: DELETE an Email Campaign from your Constant Contact account. Use this action when you need to permanently remove an email campaign that is no longer needed or was created in error. This action is irreversible — the email campaign cannot be recovered once deleted. The API returns 204 No Content on successful deletion with an empty response body.

campaign_id.description: The unique identifier of the email campaign to delete, in UUID format.

STRIPE_DELETE_INVOICE.description: Permanently deletes a draft invoice. This action cannot be undone. Use when you need to remove a draft invoice. Finalized or subscription invoices must be voided instead.

invoice.description: The identifier of the invoice to be deleted. Must start with 'in_' followed by alphanumeric characters. Only draft invoices can be deleted.

ims_attributes.description: Instant messaging attributes to add to the company

sms_attributes.description: SMS attributes to add to the company

atype.description: Type of phone number (e.g., office, mobile, fax, private)

tels_attributes.description: Telephone attributes to add to the company

avatar.description: Base64 encoded avatar image or URL

emails_attributes.description: Email attributes to add to the company

homepages_attributes.description: Homepage/website attributes to add to the company

value.description: The value for the custom field

ALTOVIZ_DELETE_SALE_INVOICE.description: Tool to delete a draft sale invoice from Altoviz. Use when you need to permanently remove a draft invoice from the system. Only draft invoices can be deleted; finalized invoices cannot be deleted.

invoice_id.description: The unique identifier of the draft invoice to delete. Only draft invoices can be deleted.

PIPELINE_CRM_CREATE_COMPANY.description: Creates a new company record in Pipeline CRM with contact details, address, and social media information. Use this tool when you need to add a new company to the CRM system. The only required field is the company name. You can optionally include contact information (email, phone, fax), address details, social media links, and assign owners or tags. Set check_for_duplicates=true to prevent creating companies with duplicate names.

company.description: Company details object. Required field: 'name' (str). Optional fields: 'email' (str), 'web' (str), 'description' (str), 'phone1/2/3/4' (str), 'phone1/2/3/4_desc' (str), 'fax' (str), 'address_1' (str), 'address_2' (str), 'city' (str), 'state' (str), 'postal_code' (int), 'country' (str), 'instant_message' (str), 'twitter' (str), 'facebook_url' (str), 'linked_in_url' (str), 'owner_id' (int), 'shared_user_ids' (list of int), 'tag_ids' (list of int), 'custom_fields' (dict).

todo_template_id.description: ID of a todo template to automatically apply to this newly created company. Creates tasks based on the template.

check_for_duplicates.description: If true, returns a 422 error when a company with the same name already exists. If false (default), allows creating duplicate companies.

todo_template_user_id.description: User ID to assign as the owner of tasks created from the todo template. Only used when todo_template_id is provided.

deliver_assignment_email.description: If true (default), sends an assignment notification email to the company owner. Set to false to create the company without sending notification emails.

SQUARE_DELETE_INVOICE.description: Tool to delete a Square invoice (only DRAFT invoices can be deleted).

version.description: The version of the invoice to delete. If you do not know the version, retrieve the invoice first via Get Invoice or List Invoices.

invoice_id.description: The Square-assigned ID of the invoice to delete. Format: 'inv:0-' followed by an alphanumeric string.

CONSTANT_CONTACT_LIST_EMAIL_CAMPAIGNS.description: GET a collection of email campaigns from Constant Contact. Use this action when you need to retrieve email campaigns from your Constant Contact account. You can filter results by creation date using before_date and after_date parameters, and control the number of results using the limit parameter. Results are paginated with optional cursor-based pagination via the next link. This is a read-only operation that returns campaign metadata including names, statuses, creation dates, and activity information. Note: The limit parameter defaults to 25 and must be between 1 and 500.

limit.description: Number of email campaigns to return (1-500).

after_date.description: Filter for campaigns created after this date (ISO 8601 format, e.g., 2024-01-01T00:00:00Z).

before_date.description: Filter for campaigns created before this date (ISO 8601 format, e.g., 2024-01-15T00:00:00Z).
